{{Quote|My children... they'll take over the facility, and kill those Stormtroopers... then Teraud will have to admit that I am smarter than he is... that I am the one that will one day rule!|Doctor Knag|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Knag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Doctor Knag was posted as a researcher at the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|Warren]], a top-secret Imperial Research Facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. During his time at the Warren, Knag and many other research [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] went rogue, and [[Teraud's Loyalists|supported]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bors Teraud]]'s ambitions to overthrow [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by creating an army of loyal [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] followers. However, this attempted coup was foiled by a dutiful citizen who infiltrated the Warren, [[Death/Legends|killed]] Doctor Knag, and submitted evidence of Colonel Teraud's treachery to the Imperial authorities.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Doctor Knag wish ''[sic]'' to begin experiments along these lines as quickly as possible, but we will need test subjects. I will inquire amongst my loyal officers to see if there are any volunteers, but until then we may wish to ''acquire'' some subjects from the Worker's Quarters on the first floor. I doubt anyone will miss them.|Message from Colonel Bors Teraud to his research staff|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] by the name of Knag served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Doctor Knag conducted research at the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|Warren]], a top-secret Imperial Research Facility in the [[Rielig Steppes]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bors Teraud]] served as both the Warren's [[Commander/Legends|commanding]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]], and as Doctor Knag's superior. With his sizeable amount of followers, the megalomaniacal Colonel believed it possible to overthrow [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and subvert his control over the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. To that end, Colonel Teraud managed to sway Doctor Knag and many other Imperial research [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to his cause. These [[Teraud's Loyalists|Teraud Loyalists]], as they were called, betrayed the Empire and supported the Colonel's plans to amass an army of mindless [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] intent on launching a coup against the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="SWG" />

The Warren descended into chaos after Colonel Teraud and his loyalists banded together to focus on their illicit [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] research. A large number of various cyborg creatures, including [[bol]]s, [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizards]], [[huurton]]s, [[Corellian slice hound|slice hounds]], and [[tusk cat]]s were left to freely roam the sprawling underground facility. A number of rogue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were also left to patrol the Warren's countless corridors. Many loyal Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Imperial officers, agitated by this insurrection of cyborgs, droids, and Teraud Loyalists, began attacking everything in sight. In addition to their cybernetics work on many of the Warren's creatures, Doctor Knag and the other scientists furthered their unsanctioned research on their fellow Humans. [[Dirk Maggin]] for instance, volunteered to be one of Teraud's Loyalists. In doing so, Maggin subjected himself to having his mind controlled by a cyborg device, eliminating his free will. A number of other Imperials were subjected to these same mind control implants, furthering Colonel Teraud's vision of creating an army of faithful cyborg [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. However, this research was not limited to only the [[Brain/Legends|brains]] of Humans and other small creatures. Colonel Teraud also ordered [[Imperial worker]]s to carve the brains out of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragons]], massive [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At least one of these Krayt dragon brains was planted inside an altered [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], turning the simple Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walker]] into a cybernetic monstrosity. The extent of this perverse scientific research drove Imperial worker [[O'Evitt Piboi]] to flee the Warren in fear.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
After escaping the Warren, O'Evitt Piboi happened across a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in the surrounding countryside. Piboi frantically explained to the spacer the horrors of what was occurring inside the corrupted confines of the Imperial Research Facility. To put an end to Colonel Teraud and his band of loyalists, the spacer accepted Piboi's [[Keycard/Legends|passkey]] and infiltrated the Warren to collect evidence of Colonel Teraud's wrongdoing. While exploring the immense confines of the Warren, the spacer battled Colonel Teraud's large band of cyborgs, droids, and loyalists. The spacer also happened upon Doctor Knag himself, who wielded his weapon in a violent attempt to subdue the spacer and turn the individual into yet another one of his cyborgs. As he began attacking the spacer, Doctor Knag revealed his true ambition to have his "children" one day take over the facility. Doctor Knag believed himself smarter than Colonel Teraud, and wanted to prove that he was destined to one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] rule. However, the doctor's self-serving ambitions were put to an end when the spacer succeeded in [[Death/Legends|killing]] him during the scuffle. Ultimately, the spacer left the Warren, not only having killed Doctor Knag, but also Colonel Teraud. The spacer also acquired hard evidence of the illicit activities conducted within the Warren. This evidence was submitted to the proper Imperial authorities in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. For their part in putting a stop to the maniacal plans of Colonel Teraud, Doctor Knag, and their other followers, the spacer was commended by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Heff (Human)|Heff]] as a hero of the Empire.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;this one will probably make a lovely cyborg...|Doctor Knag|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Doctor Knag had fair skin, gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and blue [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
During his time as a researcher at the Warren, Doctor Knag wore a white colored [[Clothing/Legends|smock]] with a dark gray [[Belt/Legends|waistband]], and black colored uniform [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. His personal arsenal consisted of multiple types of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], including a [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]], an [[FWG-5 Flechette Smart Pistol]], a [[Striker projectile pistol]], and an [[SE-14 blaster pistol]]. A [[DH-17 blaster carbine/Legends|DH-17 blaster carbine]] also served as a secondary armament for the doctor.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That one probably isn't salvageable...|Doctor Knag, when he succeeded in defeating the player in combat|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Doctor Knag was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who accepted the [[W:c:swg:The Warren|Warren]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] could encounter Knag inside the [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial]] Research Facility on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Dantooine|Dantooine]]. If the player were to attack Knag, then the doctor would reveal his plans to turn the spacer into a cyborg, and seize control of the facility for himself. If the player were to be defeated by Knag, then the doctor would remark that the player was not "salvageable" enough to be turned into a cyborg. Knag's inclusion in the Warren was only incidental to the actual quest. Killing him was optional, and it was possible for players to avoid encountering him altogether. However, this article assumes 100% [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|game]] completion, and that the player succeeded in killing Doctor Knag.<ref name="SWG" /> The game's directory tree files reveal Knag's full name to be '''Knag Garhun''', but the last name of Garhun was never mentioned in the actual game. Therefore, the last name of Garhun is ambiguously [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>
